strategic_subtitle: Build relevance before the buying window
state_to_change: selected account has fit but shallow relevance relationships or timing
trigger: account fits investment thesis but direct evidence and access remain shallow
working_hypothesis: sustained useful relevance can improve account learning and permission without implying intent
admission_gate: defined account population; fit thesis; accountable owner; monitoring capacity
intervention: context-led education and coordinated light-touch account experience
progress_evidence: broader relevant-role engagement; meaningful response; new account-team learning; permission
stop_rule: do not escalate from engagement volume alone
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; Backbase case; ABM clipping bundles; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Must remain distinct from Plant the Flag by named-account scope and from Break Into the Account by relationship objective.

strategic_subtitle: Turn a change signal into a testable hypothesis
state_to_change: uninterpreted signal becomes a bounded account hypothesis and decision
trigger: multiple contextual signals suggest a material change
working_hypothesis: triangulated context can support an owner decision to investigate activate monitor or reject
admission_gate: more than one contextual input; named owner; alternative explanation; review horizon
intervention: triangulate business relationship opportunity and customer evidence; test with account owner
progress_evidence: hypothesis validated refined rejected or routed to a next action
stop_rule: an isolated intent score is not a spark
internal_evidence: EGS; diagnostic; signal and buying-group bundle; scale-system case
overlap_or_boundary: May be a System Play or execution-loop step rather than a commercial Situation Play.

strategic_subtitle: Build shared recognition of an important change
state_to_change: buying group lacks shared recognition or language for a material problem
trigger: credible evidence suggests a problem that is not collectively understood
working_hypothesis: diagnostic insight and peer evidence can help relevant roles recognize and frame the issue
admission_gate: evidence-backed problem; relevant roles; no manufactured urgency; useful expertise
intervention: problem framing diagnostic peer evidence and role-specific discussion
progress_evidence: problem enters internal discussion; additional roles engage; diagnostic requested
stop_rule: do not manufacture urgency unsupported by account evidence
internal_evidence: EGS content-and-experience logic; ABM clipping bundles
overlap_or_boundary: Separate from Build the Case: problem recognition precedes internal justification of a chosen change.

strategic_subtitle: Establish relevance in a new market or account population
state_to_change: new market or account population lacks credible position and learning
trigger: strategic entry rationale exists but account-level evidence is insufficient
working_hypothesis: bounded market/account-population work can generate learning and identify qualified account paths
admission_gate: explicit market thesis; population boundary; learning questions; no false 1:few claim
intervention: market perspective account-population activation and structured learning
progress_evidence: clearer ICP boundaries; emerging clusters; qualified account and relationship paths
stop_rule: generic market entry must not be presented as 1:few ABM
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; EGS Market Demand and Account-based Demand boundaries
overlap_or_boundary: Potentially outside ABM when the managed unit is a market rather than selected accounts; requires a routing rule.

strategic_subtitle: Create the first legitimate relationship path
state_to_change: strategic account has no permissioned decision-relevant relationship
trigger: account is relevant but lacks a credible access route
working_hypothesis: a context-specific value-bearing route can convert anonymous relevance into permissioned access
admission_gate: strategic relevance; target role or route; credible contribution; accountable follow-up
intervention: introduction peer exchange diagnostic or partner-enabled access experience
progress_evidence: relevant role accepts a conversation introduction or useful exchange
stop_rule: contact enrichment and identity are not access or qualification
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; EGS relationship capital; public evidence access-preference observation
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Open the Door: this creates the first account path; Open the Door fills a known role gap inside an active account.

state_to_change: incumbent customer population becomes selectively open to an alternative
trigger: incumbent context shows a material unmet need change or transition risk
working_hypothesis: accounts with a shared evidenced incumbent gap may respond to a differentiated and responsible transition thesis
admission_gate: known incumbent context; material gap; transition feasibility; account fit; no assumed dissatisfaction
intervention: diagnostic comparison transition proof and role-specific risk reduction
progress_evidence: account acknowledges a gap explores alternatives or accepts comparison
stop_rule: competitor use alone does not imply dissatisfaction or readiness
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; EGS hypothesis rules; ABM clipping bundles
overlap_or_boundary: Currently names a targeting segment as much as a state change; require a specific displacement condition.

state_to_change: recent buyer decision with evidenced friction becomes open to remediation or reconsideration
trigger: credible post-decision friction or unmet expectation appears
working_hypothesis: responsible evidence and a better recovery path can reopen a future decision window
admission_gate: direct or triangulated dissatisfaction evidence; ethical timing; credible alternative or remediation
intervention: diagnostic remediation comparison or contingency conversation
progress_evidence: account explores remediation contingency comparison or a later decision window
stop_rule: do not exploit assumed dissatisfaction or disrupt implementation without evidence
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; EGS evidence and stop rules
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Reopen Closed-Lost: this follows a competitor or alternative decision and may precede a formal new opportunity.

state_to_change: quiet high-potential account receives a current activate monitor demote or exit decision
trigger: new evidence may invalidate the old account thesis timing route or relationship map
working_hypothesis: requalification can distinguish dormant potential from logo-based wishful thinking
admission_gate: structural potential; new evidence; named owner; explicit portfolio consequence
intervention: refresh account thesis evidence route and portfolio status
progress_evidence: activate monitor demote or exit decision
stop_rule: do not keep accounts active permanently because of logo value
internal_evidence: EGS dynamic portfolio; scale-system and CrossKnowledge cases
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Wake the Dead: account-level portfolio state versus a previously active opportunity.

strategic_subtitle: Discover how the decision really works
state_to_change: unclear decision system becomes a living evidence-based buying-group map
trigger: material account decision involves multiple roles and unknown influence paths
working_hypothesis: mapping roles relationships evidence and unknowns improves next-action quality
admission_gate: material decision; accountable account owner; evidence provenance; update cadence
intervention: role and relationship mapping with explicit unknowns and tests
progress_evidence: better role coverage; fewer material unknowns; testable decision path
stop_rule: a purchased contact list is not a buying-group map
internal_evidence: EGS; diagnostic; signal/buying-group bundle; Backbase and scale-system cases
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with system play Map the Buying Group: this is a bounded account intervention; the system play provides repeatable infrastructure.

strategic_subtitle: Earn access to a missing critical role
state_to_change: known decision-critical role changes from inaccessible to permissioned participation
trigger: team knows which missing role materially affects progress
working_hypothesis: a legitimate value-bearing route can earn access or reveal a better route
admission_gate: role is demonstrably decision-critical; reason for access; credible contribution; owner
intervention: targeted introduction workshop peer exchange or partner/executive route
progress_evidence: accepted interaction contribution or evidence of a preferable route
stop_rule: seniority alone does not make a role critical
internal_evidence: EGS relationships; ServiceNow pursuit; public evidence access-preference observation
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Break Into the Account by known missing role and existing account context.

state_to_change: single-threaded relationship becomes resilient decision-role coverage
trigger: progress depends disproportionately on one contact
working_hypothesis: purposeful multithreading reduces continuity and decision risk
admission_gate: known decision roles; relationship owners; value for each interaction; consent
intervention: develop distinct sponsor champion evaluator user commercial and risk relationships
progress_evidence: multiple relevant relationships with different decision jobs and owners
stop_rule: contact volume is not multithreading without decision coverage
internal_evidence: EGS relationship capital; NTT; ServiceNow; Universal Robots continuity observation
overlap_or_boundary: Map the Room identifies the system; Build the Bench changes relationship coverage within it.

strategic_subtitle: Help an internal supporter become effective
state_to_change: supportive contact becomes able to mobilize internal attention evidence and alignment
trigger: credible supporter has motivation but lacks case network or organizational support
working_hypothesis: buyer-enablement support can help a credible supporter advance an internally owned decision
admission_gate: motivation; credibility; relevant problem; ethical support; no proxy selling
intervention: equip supporter with evidence decision tools stakeholder paths and tests
progress_evidence: supporter brings roles advances discussion or tests the hypothesis
stop_rule: enthusiasm must not be mislabeled as influence
internal_evidence: EGS buyer progress logic; clipping bundles
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Build the Case because the unit of change is champion capability rather than the collective justification artifact.

strategic_subtitle: Transfer relationship capital after a move
state_to_change: proven relationship is requalified in a new organizational context
trigger: trusted champion changes role or company
working_hypothesis: relationship permission may create access but only a new context-specific problem creates a play
admission_gate: proven prior relationship; explicit permission; new-context research; plausible problem
intervention: reconnect listen and build a fresh account hypothesis
progress_evidence: permissioned conversation and validated or rejected new hypothesis
stop_rule: a person's move does not automatically create an opportunity
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; EGS relationship and hypothesis rules
overlap_or_boundary: A trigger-led play whose admission must prevent automatic opportunity creation.

state_to_change: material trust decision ambition or sponsorship gap changes through peer authority
trigger: operating teams cannot resolve a defined executive-level condition
working_hypothesis: a credible peer contribution can change a specific decision condition
admission_gate: defined executive job; relevant peer; briefing; follow-through; relationship-risk check
intervention: bounded executive interaction tied to a decision or relationship objective
progress_evidence: obstacle changes; sponsorship strengthens; strategic conversation advances
stop_rule: executive theatre without a decision job wastes relationship capital
internal_evidence: EGS orchestration; ServiceNow pursuit; NTT embedded model
overlap_or_boundary: Executive-to-Executive format is the delivery configuration; Bring in the Boss is the account situation.

state_to_change: material resistance becomes understood resolved accepted or a stop decision
trigger: relevant role has a material addressable concern
working_hypothesis: respectful diagnosis and evidence can improve decision quality even when the outcome is stop
admission_gate: legitimate role and concern; accountable owner; evidence; no circumvention of controls
intervention: listen clarify test evidence address risk or accept constraint
progress_evidence: concern is clarified reduced accepted or becomes a stop condition
stop_rule: do not manipulate or route around risk compliance procurement or user concerns
internal_evidence: EGS risk and decision logic; public evidence buyer-side challenge
overlap_or_boundary: Avoid adversarial language; test an editorial alternative such as Earn the Skeptic while retaining the precise subtitle.

strategic_subtitle: Change an outdated or damaging perception
state_to_change: obsolete or negative account perception becomes evidence-based and current
trigger: perception blocks access or consideration and underlying reality has changed
working_hypothesis: credible changed behavior proof and experience can update account assumptions
admission_gate: root cause understood; reality genuinely changed; proof; accountable delivery
intervention: evidence-led experience relationship repair proof and targeted dialogue
progress_evidence: new roles engage; assumptions update; strategic conversation reopens
stop_rule: messaging cannot repair a proposition delivery or trust problem that remains true
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; ServiceNow pursuit; EGS experience and evidence rules
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Repair the Relationship: reputation is an account belief; repair addresses an experienced failure and trust relationship.

strategic_subtitle: Use the ecosystem to create the right access route
state_to_change: unclear or conflicting route-to-customer becomes an owned partner customer or joint path
trigger: partner controls access rights trust incentives or delivery
working_hypothesis: explicit route design can prevent channel conflict and improve customer continuity
admission_gate: credible customer value; named partner and direct owners; rights and incentives; conflict check
intervention: choose and contract partner-first customer-first or joint orchestration
progress_evidence: clear ownership aligned incentives and permissioned customer path
stop_rule: partner is part of the commercial system not merely a media channel
internal_evidence: Universal Robots case; public evidence partner-route observation; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Partner-First is a format used after this situation-level route decision.

state_to_change: context-rich account response becomes a permissioned diagnostic interaction
trigger: response connects to a plausible problem role and account hypothesis
working_hypothesis: preserving context across the handoff can create a useful conversation
admission_gate: meaningful response; plausible problem; relevant role; agreed response owner
intervention: context transfer and tailored invitation to a diagnostic or referral interaction
progress_evidence: relevant conversation diagnostic exchange or referral
stop_rule: do not launch indiscriminate cadence from low-context engagement
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; revenue-execution bundle; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Meeting conversion may be a tactic or progression event rather than a material commercial state; strongest Gate 1 removal/reclassification candidate.

strategic_subtitle: Turn an account hypothesis into a commercial initiative
state_to_change: account hypothesis becomes a jointly recognized initiative and decision process
trigger: material problem relationship path and value hypothesis support direct work
working_hypothesis: joint problem definition can create a legitimate commercial initiative without manufacturing pipeline
admission_gate: evidence-backed problem; customer participation; owner; value hypothesis; next decision
intervention: diagnostic co-definition stakeholder alignment and bounded next commitment
progress_evidence: recognized initiative decision process owner and next commitment
stop_rule: do not create CRM opportunity merely to satisfy targets
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; CrossKnowledge case; EGS opportunity and hypothesis logic
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Teach the Problem is buyer recognition; boundary with Help Land is pre-opportunity creation versus qualified opportunity support.

strategic_subtitle: Coordinate the path to an initial win
state_to_change: qualified new-account decision progresses through improved access proof and confidence
trigger: material new-account opportunity is qualified and marketing can change a defined condition
working_hypothesis: coordinated account-based support can improve a specific decision condition while sales retains ownership
admission_gate: qualified opportunity; committed account team; buying-group path; capacity; defined objective
intervention: orchestrated insight proof relationship access and decision-relevant experience
progress_evidence: buying-group access accepted proof reduced risk decision progression or commitment
stop_rule: marketing does not own forecast negotiation or close
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; ServiceNow pursuit; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Pursuit Marketing is a possible delivery format; this remains the commercial situation.

strategic_subtitle: Influence the decision before the document freezes it
state_to_change: pre-procurement decision frame becomes clearer and outcome-led
trigger: legitimate access exists before or early in formal procurement
working_hypothesis: substantive expertise can help buyers improve criteria risks and requirements without undermining choice
admission_gate: buyer permission; pre-RFP timing; relevant expertise; procurement ethics; documented boundaries
intervention: workshops diagnostics outcome framing implementation and risk evidence
progress_evidence: clearer requirements evaluation logic stakeholder involvement or differentiated value recognition
stop_rule: do not manipulate procurement or restrict fair buyer choice
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; ServiceNow and Universal Robots pursuit evidence; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Build the Case: this shapes evaluation design; Build the Case supports internal justification.

strategic_subtitle: Help the buying group justify change
state_to_change: fragmented rationale becomes a credible shared economic operational strategic and risk case
trigger: change is plausible but internal justification is incomplete
working_hypothesis: buyer-controlled evidence and assumptions can help the group justify or reject action
admission_gate: recognized problem; participating roles; defensible assumptions; uncertainty disclosure
intervention: co-create decision logic evidence assumptions scenarios and role-specific value
progress_evidence: shared case clearer assumptions stronger alignment and explicit decision path
stop_rule: do not present speculative ROI as precise fact
internal_evidence: EGS buyer progress; public evidence buyer-side research; clipping bundles
overlap_or_boundary: Separate from Teach the Problem and Close the Confidence Gap by decision stage and job.

strategic_subtitle: Help the buying group move beyond the status quo
state_to_change: collective ambiguity misalignment or risk becomes an explicit proceed smaller-step or stop decision
trigger: problem is real but group cannot make a confident collective choice
working_hypothesis: decision enablement can reduce ambiguity without treating caution as an objection
admission_gate: real problem; multiple roles; diagnosed decision friction; buyer control
intervention: decision criteria alignment workshop risk clarification and smaller reversible next step
progress_evidence: shared criteria resolved conflict smaller step or explicit stop
stop_rule: do not override legitimate buyer caution
internal_evidence: EGS decision logic; public evidence buyer-side challenge; revenue-execution bundle
overlap_or_boundary: Potential overlap with Build the Case and Close the Confidence Gap; retain only with explicit collective-decision boundary.

state_to_change: late-stage uncertainty becomes validated confidence or an explicit unresolved gap
trigger: buying group understands value but faces material implementation proof security or governance uncertainty
working_hypothesis: decision-specific proof and access can validate critical assumptions
admission_gate: qualified decision; named uncertainty and risk owner; credible proof path; delivery readiness
intervention: reference proof workshop sandbox expert access implementation plan or governance evidence
progress_evidence: critical assumptions validated; risk-owner confidence; implementation agreement
stop_rule: content cannot solve unresolved product delivery security or commercial gaps
internal_evidence: ServiceNow pursuit; EGS content/experience and readiness rules
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Rescue the Deal: confidence gap is diagnosed uncertainty; rescue is broader at-risk opportunity intervention.

strategic_subtitle: Stabilize a strategically important opportunity at risk
state_to_change: recoverable strategic opportunity risk becomes stabilized progressed or exited
trigger: material opportunity is at risk for an addressable account condition
working_hypothesis: bounded diagnosis and coordinated action can change a specific risk
admission_gate: materiality; recoverability; committed owners; capacity; account evidence; exit authority
intervention: pursuit-style diagnosis and targeted relationship proof access or decision intervention
progress_evidence: risk changes; missing role engages; corrective interaction accepted; responsible exit
stop_rule: do not convert every forecast problem into an ABM emergency
internal_evidence: ServiceNow pursuit; EGS; 2023 deck context
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Wake the Dead: currently active but at-risk versus stalled/inactive decision process.

state_to_change: stalled opportunity becomes requalified reactivated reframed or exited
trigger: new evidence changes priority people economics risk competition or timing
working_hypothesis: a materially new reason can reopen the decision while repeated follow-up cannot
admission_gate: known stall history; new evidence; accountable owner; plausible next decision
intervention: re-diagnose the stall build a new hypothesis and offer a changed path
progress_evidence: renewed decision process smaller step or documented exit
stop_rule: repeating the old sequence is not reactivation
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; ServiceNow pursuit context; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Sleeping Giant by opportunity history and from Reopen Closed-Lost by no completed loss decision.

state_to_change: completed loss decision becomes legitimately reconsiderable or remains closed
trigger: account conditions leadership incumbent performance proposition or timing materially changed
working_hypothesis: understood loss plus changed conditions may support responsible re-entry
admission_gate: documented loss reason; material change; new hypothesis; permission-sensitive route
intervention: requalify and present only the changed evidence and next decision
progress_evidence: legitimate re-entry new learning or confirmation to remain closed
stop_rule: elapsed calendar time alone is not a change event
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; EGS portfolio and hypothesis rules
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Ping for Buyer's Remorse depends on formal loss history and current decision window.

strategic_subtitle: Turn the sale into successful adoption
state_to_change: commercial commitment becomes outcome-aligned implementation adoption and early value
trigger: new customer or use case moves into implementation and adoption
working_hypothesis: early cross-functional alignment can protect the promised value and future relationship
admission_gate: agreed outcomes; implementation owners; stakeholder readiness; delivery capacity; evidence plan
intervention: outcome alignment onboarding coordination adoption support and early-value review
progress_evidence: agreed outcomes role readiness adoption milestones confidence and early value evidence
stop_rule: onboarding communication is not proof of adoption
internal_evidence: EGS Customer Expansion; NTT embedded model; ServiceNow customer branch
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Fix the Friction: proactive transition versus recovery from observed adoption barriers.

strategic_subtitle: Make realized value visible and credible
state_to_change: fragmented or invisible realized value becomes validated stakeholder-recognized evidence
trigger: value may exist but is not connected to stakeholder priorities
working_hypothesis: joint evidence can make value usable for customer and account decisions without false attribution
admission_gate: observable outcome; customer participation; baseline or credible counterfactual limits; claim discipline
intervention: value review evidence synthesis customer validation and stakeholder communication
progress_evidence: validated value evidence stakeholder recognition sponsorship and informed next decisions
stop_rule: do not turn influence or activity into unsupported outcome claims
internal_evidence: EGS layered measurement; NTT; revenue-execution bundle
overlap_or_boundary: A prerequisite or companion for renewal expansion advocacy and defense; not itself proof of causal attribution.

state_to_change: recoverable adoption or experience barrier becomes reduced owned or explicitly bounded
trigger: use enablement process trust delivery or ownership is weaker than expected
working_hypothesis: diagnosis and coordinated correction can restore use and confidence before growth
admission_gate: evidenced friction; root-cause access; accountable delivery owners; recoverability
intervention: diagnose barriers coordinate corrective enablement process product or ownership action
progress_evidence: reduced barriers improved use clearer ownership restored confidence or limitation
stop_rule: do not sell around unresolved customer-health problems
internal_evidence: EGS Customer Expansion; ServiceNow recovery contexts; NTT account proximity
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Recover the Account: local adoption friction versus material multi-dimensional account-health problem.

state_to_change: narrow transactional relationship becomes broader outcome and stakeholder relevance
trigger: existing health and value justify a wider relationship hypothesis
working_hypothesis: proven value plus purposeful multithreading can support broader shared planning
admission_gate: healthy relationship; validated value; relevant adjacent priorities; account-team commitment
intervention: strategic discovery relationship mapping and co-owned planning
progress_evidence: new strategic conversations stronger multithreading and shared priorities
stop_rule: relationship expansion without customer value becomes extraction
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; NTT embedded model; EGS relationship capital
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Expand Into the Customer Organization: depth and breadth of relationship versus entry into a distinct unit.

strategic_subtitle: Move into a new business unit
state_to_change: validated customer value becomes a unit-specific opportunity in another buying group
trigger: new unit has a relevant problem and existing relationship supplies legitimate proof or access
working_hypothesis: validated learning may transfer if the new unit independently fits
admission_gate: existing value; unit-specific problem; local sponsor; decision rights; adapted evidence
intervention: revalidate context transfer proof build local hypothesis and route
progress_evidence: unit-specific hypothesis sponsor decision path and evidence plan
stop_rule: same logo does not make the new unit a copy
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; Universal Robots site expansion; NTT controlled reuse
overlap_or_boundary: Cross the Border is a geographic subtype; Plant the Next Use Case changes value scope rather than organization.

state_to_change: current value becomes a validated adjacent use-case hypothesis
trigger: current value is credible and an adjacent customer problem merits exploration
working_hypothesis: problem-led adjacency can create legitimate expansion while product adjacency alone cannot
admission_gate: realized value; adjacent problem evidence; relevant roles; bounded exploration
intervention: use-case discovery hypothesis testing and small evidence plan
progress_evidence: validated use-case hypothesis engaged roles and bounded next step
stop_rule: product adjacency is not automatically customer adjacency
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; NTT learning transfer; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Grow Together: known adjacent use case versus joint creation of a new capability.

state_to_change: validated relationship becomes a locally adapted geographic expansion path
trigger: value pattern may transfer and global and local owners are engaged
working_hypothesis: global evidence can enable but not replace local validation rights partners and adoption context
admission_gate: healthy base; local problem; global/local owners; route rights; delivery capacity
intervention: local discovery adapted hypothesis partner/owner alignment and adoption plan
progress_evidence: local validation aligned ownership and credible route to adoption
stop_rule: global contract does not eliminate local context
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; Universal Robots case; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Geographic subtype of Expand Into the Customer Organization; external research should test whether a subtype deserves a separate play.

strategic_subtitle: Co-create a new capability or solution
state_to_change: shared strategic problem becomes a governed joint experiment and scale decision
trigger: both sides have aligned value learning intent capacity and rights
working_hypothesis: co-creation can deepen value when scope ownership evidence and IP are explicit
admission_gate: shared problem; sponsor; capacity; IP and risk rules; learning questions; exit
intervention: bounded co-design experiment shared evidence and scale review
progress_evidence: experiment evidence explicit ownership and scale continue or stop decision
stop_rule: do not hide unfunded customization or unclear IP
internal_evidence: EGS experimentation and customer value logic; NTT creative experimentation context
overlap_or_boundary: External evidence needed to distinguish ABM play from product/service co-creation methodology.

editorial_name: Turn the Customer Into an Advocate
state_to_change: satisfied customer becomes a willing independent contributor to peer evidence
trigger: value is real customer consents and advocacy benefits both parties
working_hypothesis: earned customer voice can create credible peer learning while remaining independent
admission_gate: customer-validated value; explicit consent; mutual benefit; rights and withdrawal path
intervention: reference peer exchange community contribution or customer-authored evidence
progress_evidence: willing reference participation peer contribution or customer-authored evidence
stop_rule: do not pressure customers or script away independent perspective
internal_evidence: EGS customer advocacy outcome; NTT and clipping context
overlap_or_boundary: Advocacy is a customer-state play; events references and content are formats/tactics.

strategic_subtitle: Start renewal readiness before the deadline
state_to_change: future renewal decision becomes evidence-ready before commercial urgency
trigger: known renewal horizon leaves time to change adoption value relationship or risk
working_hypothesis: working backward from the decision can surface and resolve underlying conditions early
admission_gate: renewal date; health/value evidence; owners; sufficient lead time; customer plan
intervention: renewal-back planning value and relationship reviews risk actions and proof
progress_evidence: gaps surface early; owners act; confidence becomes evidence-based
stop_rule: communication calendar cannot compensate for weak value realization
internal_evidence: 2023 deck; ServiceNow customer branch; EGS
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Defend the Base by explicit decision horizon and from Save the Renewal by non-acute risk.

state_to_change: material recoverable renewal risk becomes corrected reframed or responsibly lost
trigger: renewal risk is explicit recoverable and owners can change root causes
working_hypothesis: bounded cross-functional recovery can change the underlying renewal condition
admission_gate: explicit risk; root cause; accountable owners; delivery capacity; decision window
intervention: diagnose and coordinate product delivery success relationship value and commercial correction
progress_evidence: root cause changes trust improves value restores and renewal path emerges
stop_rule: marketing cannot message around unresolved delivery failure
internal_evidence: ServiceNow pursuit; EGS; 2023 deck renewal context
overlap_or_boundary: Pursuit Marketing may be the format; Recover the Account may precede it when health failure is broader than the renewal decision.

state_to_change: healthy strategic customer remains relevant multithreaded and competitively resilient
trigger: healthy important account faces complacency or competitive exposure
working_hypothesis: proactive value visibility relationship depth and future alignment can reduce preventable erosion
admission_gate: healthy account; strategic importance; evidence of exposure; useful cadence; no over-contact
intervention: value review relationship development future-priority alignment and competitive monitoring
progress_evidence: stronger multithreading current value evidence and known risks
stop_rule: defense must not become unnecessary contact or restrictive behavior
internal_evidence: EGS Customer Expansion; NTT embedded model; 2023 deck context
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with T-Minus Renewal: always-on resilience versus date-bound renewal readiness.

state_to_change: evidenced scope-reduction risk becomes restored value agreed right-size or accepted reduction
trigger: adoption value budget organization or relationship threatens scope
working_hypothesis: root-cause action may protect only the scope that remains useful to the customer
admission_gate: evidenced risk; legitimate retained value; accountable owners; right-sizing option
intervention: diagnose use/value and coordinate corrective or right-sizing plan
progress_evidence: root causes clear; use/value restored; scope agreed or responsibly reduced
stop_rule: do not defend unused or unnecessary capacity
internal_evidence: ServiceNow pursuit contexts; EGS customer-value boundary
overlap_or_boundary: Distinct from Save the Renewal by scope not contract continuity; may share Pursuit format.

strategic_subtitle: Restore trust after failure or conflict
state_to_change: damaged working trust becomes evidence-based confidence or an honest limit
trigger: failure escalation misalignment or broken expectation damaged access and trust
working_hypothesis: acknowledgment corrective action and consistent follow-through can restore a working relationship
admission_gate: issue acknowledged; accountable owner; capacity to change behavior; customer willingness
intervention: shared-fact review corrective plan follow-through and expectation reset
progress_evidence: restored access clearer expectations and evidence of changed behavior
stop_rule: reputation messaging cannot substitute for repair
internal_evidence: ServiceNow recovery contexts; EGS trust and orchestration logic
overlap_or_boundary: Boundary with Reset the Reputation is experienced relationship failure versus broader outdated perception.

strategic_subtitle: Reset the account after leadership change
state_to_change: leadership-dependent account model becomes revalidated under a new decision owner
trigger: critical leader changes and affects sponsorship rights strategy or continuity
working_hypothesis: respectful re-discovery can preserve valid evidence and replace invalid assumptions
admission_gate: material leadership change; prior value evidence; updated role map; permissioned route
intervention: listen update priorities revalidate value relationships risks and account decision
progress_evidence: updated priorities new relationship path and revised account decision
stop_rule: do not assume inherited commitments or replay the old narrative
internal_evidence: 2023 deck context; Universal Robots continuity observation; EGS dynamic decisions
overlap_or_boundary: A specific change-trigger play; Survive the Reorg covers structural rather than individual leadership change.

strategic_subtitle: Rebuild the operating map after structural change
state_to_change: obsolete post-reorg account model becomes a current ownership budget and relationship map
trigger: reorganization or M&A invalidates ownership budgets relationships or delivery paths
working_hypothesis: explicit revalidation prevents execution against an organization that no longer exists
admission_gate: material structural change; account importance; accessible evidence; owner; decision horizon
intervention: remap organization relationships use cases rights budgets and continuation logic
progress_evidence: refreshed map new owners revised hypotheses and continue demote or exit decision
stop_rule: do not continue against obsolete structure
internal_evidence: Universal Robots continuity observation; EGS dynamic portfolio and relationships
overlap_or_boundary: May connect to Welcome the New Boss but has a distinct structural state.

state_to_change: material multi-dimensional customer-health problem becomes recovered bounded or exited
trigger: strategic account problem is recoverable and accountable functions can change conditions
working_hypothesis: cross-functional recovery can restore health only by changing product delivery adoption relationship or ownership reality
admission_gate: materiality; root-cause access; committed product/delivery/success/commercial owners; exit authority
intervention: account recovery team diagnosis corrective plan customer communication and health evidence
progress_evidence: improved health confidence adoption delivery relationship or honest exit
stop_rule: recovery is not an expansion campaign with softer language
internal_evidence: ServiceNow pursuit contexts; EGS Customer Expansion; NTT embedded proximity
overlap_or_boundary: Umbrella recovery state; Fix the Friction Repair the Relationship and Save the Renewal may be narrower component plays.

state_to_change: churned or lost customer becomes permissioned to reconsider because something material changed
trigger: loss reason is known and proposition operating reality relationship or context changed
working_hypothesis: credible change plus accountable acknowledgment can create a new bounded initiative
admission_gate: documented loss reason; material changed condition; delivery readiness; respectful route
intervention: reconnect acknowledge history present changed evidence and test a small new initiative
progress_evidence: permission to re-engage acknowledgment of change bounded initiative or responsible no
stop_rule: nostalgia logo value and elapsed time do not justify win-back
